judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote a `.lore/dod.md` file, a single failing acceptance test (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), and a four-line stub in `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`. It did not implement any production code whatsoever—none of the message types in `src/types/messages.ts`, `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, `StoreCannotList`, validation in `validation.ts`, message handling in `messageHandler.ts`, or configuration options in `src/config.ts` and `createServer.ts` were touched. Because the feature was not implemented, the added test will fail with an `INVALID_MESSAGE` error frame rather than returning `conversation_list`. Furthermore, the candidate's `.lore/dod.md` explicitly declared core acceptance criteria from the ticket (paging validation, disabled-history errors, store failure handling) as out of scope.
